summary: Filters can handle missing variables by providing defaults or making variables optional, and the mandatory filter can require values when undefined variables are otherwise ignored.
questions: How can I handle undefined variables in Ansible templates?

answer_card.title: Handling undefined variables with filters
answer_card.answer_md: Use filters to supply **defaults**, make variables **optional** (`omit`), or, if you've configured Ansible to ignore undefined variables, require specific ones with **`mandatory`**.
